root.command: SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) AS LastSuccessfulCheckup, COUNT(*) AS TotalRemindersSent, DateDiff("d", MAX(DateSentReminder), Now()) AS DaysSinceLastCheckup FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True
SELECT MinReminderDate, DateDiff("d", MinReminderDate, Now()) AS DaysSinceMinReminder FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID = 1

SELECT 'Using NOW() (OLD LOGIC)' AS FilterMethod, COUNT(*) AS CustomersFound FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE ((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now())) AND (c.enabled = True) AND (c.PredictionDisabled = False) AND (cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1)) AND ((nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy)) OR c.AlwaysSendChkUp = True) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT o.CustomerID FROM OrdersTbl AS o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()))) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate >= Now() -- OLD LOGIC: Uses Now()
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Using LAST CHECKUP DATE (NEW LOGIC)' AS FilterMethod, COUNT(*) AS CustomersFound FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE ((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now())) AND (c.enabled = True) AND (c.PredictionDisabled = False) AND (cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1)) AND ((nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy)) OR c.AlwaysSendChkUp = True) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT o.CustomerID FROM OrdersTbl AS o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()))) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) AND nr.NextDeliveryDate >= IIF( (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True) IS NULL, (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1), (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True) ) -- NEW LOGIC: Uses last checkup date or MinReminderDate

SELECT TOP 10 c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, cu.NextCoffeeBy, nr.NextDeliveryDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), cu.NextCoffeeBy) AS DaysUntilNextCoffee, DateDiff("d", Now(), nr.NextDeliveryDate) AS DaysUntilDelivery, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate < Now(), 'PAST (Would be filtered by OLD logic)', 'FUTURE (OK with both logics)') AS DeliveryStatus, IIF(nr.NextDeliveryDate >= (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True), 'INCLUDED by NEW logic', 'EXCLUDED by NEW logic') AS NewLogicStatus FROM (CustomersTbl AS c INNER JOIN ClientUsageTbl AS cu ON c.CustomerID = cu.CustomerID) LEFT JOIN NextRoastDateByCityTbl AS nr ON c.City = nr.CityID WHERE ((c.LastDateSentReminder IS NULL) OR (c.LastDateSentReminder <> Now())) AND (c.enabled = True) AND (c.PredictionDisabled = False) AND (cu.NextCoffeeBy > (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1)) AND ((nr.NextDeliveryDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, cu.NextCoffeeBy)) OR c.AlwaysSendChkUp = True) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT o.CustomerID FROM OrdersTbl AS o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.RoastDate >= Now() AND o.RoastDate <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()))) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy >= DateAdd("d", 6, Now()) AND cu.NextCoffeeBy <= DateAdd("d", 10, Now()) ORDER BY nr.NextDeliveryDate

SELECT Now() AS CurrentDate, (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True) AS LastCheckupDate, (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1) AS MinReminderDate, IIF( (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True) IS NULL, (SELECT MinReminderDate FROM SysDataTbl WHERE ID=1), IIF( (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True) < Now(), (SELECT MAX(DateSentReminder) FROM SentRemindersLogTbl WHERE ReminderSent = True), Now() ) ) AS DeliveryFilterDate, 'Use the earlier of LastCheckup or Now' AS Explanation
